newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share market dull, block deals dominate.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share market dull, block deals dominate.

text.p: The Singapore stock market traded lower in lacklustre mid-morning trade on Thursday, with the bulk of activity dominated by block deals, dealers said.
"Nothing has changed to draw the excitement or interest of foreign funds into this market," a dealer with a local institution said.
Dealers said Hong Kong continued to shine against other bourses like Taiwan, Seoul and even Malaysia.
At 0230 GMT, the key Straits Times Industrials Index was down 14.03 points at 2,121.43. Market volume was a meagre 14.2 million shares.
Dealers said block deals comprised about a quarter of total volume.

Jardine Strategic topped the actives with 1.2 million shares, of which 1.18 million were crossed at US$3.30. Other actives included Jardine Matheson with 662,000 shares of which 550,000 were crossed at US$5.80.

Losers led gainers at 82 to 62. Among gainers were Jurong Cement, UOB Foreign and SIA Ltd Foreign which rose S$0.10-0.15. Again the bulk of these trades were crossed. Cerebos Pacific led losers, shedding S$0.50 to S$10.80. Debutante NatSteel Broadway traded below IPO price, at US0.655.
